definition: The claim is inaccurate according to the best publicly available evidence.
includes: Conspiracy theories; false context of an image or video; fabricated content

definition: The claim is correct and accurate according to the best publicly available evidence.
There might be elements that are accurate but presented in a misleading way.
The claim is satirical and intended to be taken as a joke.
The content has been manipulated, faked, or transformed audio, video, or photos.
The content has some factual inaccuracies. A mix of both True and False claims.
When the claim is a dishonest scheme, or fraud, and uses a trick to deceive.
includes: "Too good to be true" offers; impersonation of a genuine source
